The plate spans about 400 px in the image, so I treated it as a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, which gives about 0.065 cm per px... more precisely 26 cm / 400 px.

- **Chicken slices:** The cluster covers about 130 × 150 px, roughly 8 × 10 cm. It is about 1.5 cm thick, and the slices only partly fill that area, so I estimated about 90 g.
- **Cucumber slices:** The pieces cover about 150 × 130 px with partial coverage. Taking about 6 slices at roughly 10 g each, I estimated about 60 g.
- **Hummus:** The dollop is about 90 × 100 px, roughly 5.5 × 6 cm. It is about 1.5 cm high, so I estimated about 50 g.
